finding_id.description: stable id, unique across directions: <direction>-<SEV>-<n> with SEV in BLK/MAJ/MIN/NIT/INF, e.g. critical-BLK-1

severity.description: the severity-table row for effect/exposure; INFO exactly when fix is "none"

effect.description: what goes wrong if this ships as-is — destructive: data lost or corrupted, a security boundary crossed, an irreversible migration; incorrect: a wrong result, a crash, a broken promise, or a required behavior that is absent (checklist cites the item); degraded: works but slower, noisier, leakier, harder to operate — users or operators feel it; debt: only developers feel it — maintainability, tests, tooling; cosmetic: no functional effect

exposure.description: how much of normal operation hits it — always: every use; often: a common configuration, input class or state, named in evidence; rare: an unusual but real input, state or timing, named; eventually: nobody today — needs code that does not exist or an unreachable state

claim.description: the defect and why it violates the direction standard

fix.description: concrete proposed fix — one sentence or a short diff sketch

evidence.description: the lane's confirmation pass — what was re-read and why the claim holds; the claim's first confirmation (in question until the station re-verifies); lane artifacts only — ranked_plan entries omit it

checklist.description: the checklist item this finding answers — a context entry id on rule directions, <direction>-<n> on correctness and contracts; a walk-item FAIL always cites its item here, never a prose quote

route.description: station-assigned fix route on ranked_plan entries only: human (needs author judgment, surfaced at the gate) | auto-fix (applied by the fix-apply stage)

route_reason.description: ranked_plan entries only: one sentence why the route — the judgment a human must make, or why the fix is mechanical

known.description: ranked_plan entries only: true when the claim matches a KNOWN-FINDINGS ledger entry — carried from a prior round, never blocking, never routed for a fix this round

known_id.description: ranked_plan entries only, with known: the finding_id of the ledger row the claim matched

artifact.description: ranked_plan entries only: the lane artifact path

artifact_id.description: ranked_plan entries only: the finding's id inside that artifact
